Package ca.ucalgary.ensf380.data

Class DataProvider

java.lang.Object
ca.ucalgary.ensf380.data.DataProvider
public class DataProvider extends Object
Author:
Fateh Ali The DataProvider class is responsible for managing and providing data related to stations and trains. It interacts with a LatestOutputReader to fetch real-time train data and provides various methods to access station coordinates, train coordinates, station names, and other information.

  • Constructor Details

    • DataProvider

      public DataProvider()
      Constructs a DataProvider object. This constructor initializes the LatestOutputReader and retrieves the list of stations from the ReadSubwayFile class.

  • Method Details

    • getTrains

      public List<Train> getTrains()
      Retrieves the latest list of trains from the LatestOutputReader.
      Returns:
      a list of Train objects representing the current train data.

    • getStations

      public List<Station> getStations()
      Retrieves the list of stations.
      Returns:
      a list of Station objects representing the available stations.

    • getStationCoordinates

      public List<int[]> getStationCoordinates()
      Calculates and returns the coordinates for each station on the map. The coordinates are scaled based on the panel size.
      Returns:
      a list of integer arrays where each array represents the x and y coordinates of a station on the map.

    • getTrainCoordinates

      public List<int[]> getTrainCoordinates()
      Calculates and returns the coordinates for each train based on its current station. The coordinates are scaled and returned as a list of integer arrays.
      Returns:
      a list of integer arrays where each array represents the x and y coordinates of a train based on its current station.

    • getTrainCoordinatesForTrainNumber

      public List<int[]> getTrainCoordinatesForTrainNumber(String trainNumb)
      Calculates and returns the coordinates for a specific train based on its train number. The coordinates are scaled and returned as a list of integer arrays.
      Parameters:
      trainNumb - the number of the train for which coordinates are to be fetched.
      Returns:
      a list of integer arrays representing the x and y coordinates of the specified train.

    • getStationNamesForTrain

      public List<String> getStationNamesForTrain(String trainNum)
      Retrieves and returns a list of station names for a specific train, including the current, previous, and next stations.
      Parameters:
      trainNum - the number of the train for which station names are to be fetched.
      Returns:
      a list of strings where each string represents a station name.

    • getColorForStation

      public Color getColorForStation(int stationIndex)
      Returns the color corresponding to the station code's prefix.
      Parameters:
      stationIndex - the index of the station in the list.
      Returns:
      the color associated with the station (e.g., RED for 'R', BLUE for 'B', GREEN for 'G', and BLACK if none left).

    • startReadingTrains

      public void startReadingTrains()
      Starts a new thread to continuously read and update train data using the LatestOutputReader.
